pages.title: Fishy Advice
pages.text: Read the conditions before a longer fishing trip.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: JEI shows the Note’s recipe. Use it to look up the time, depth, temperature and weather for a catch.

pages.title: Record a fish discovery
pages.text: Pick up new fish and inspect the Fishing Journal: discoveries, first catch, total catches, smallest and largest sizes, and habitat conditions.

pages.title: Plan a journal completion objective
pages.text: Completing the journal remains its own fishing goal. This book makes that possibility discoverable without making every fish mandatory for the main campaign.
